source: https://github.com/LandSandBoat/server/blob/base/data/skills.yaml (ranks + caps; replaces the old sql/skill_caps.sql, sql/skill_ranks.sql)
https://github.com/IzaKastra/wsdist_beta/blob/main/create_player.py (community damage simulator, used as an extra cross-check)
note: 攻撃・命中・飛攻・飛命の計算に使う表。skills は武器の種類 (id は装備データの skill の番号、kind は one = 片手 / two = 両手 / h2h = 格闘 / ranged = 遠隔)、caps はスキルの段階ごとの Lv99 の上限、ratings はジョブごとの段階。計算は web/basestats.js。出典で食い違う点: (1) スキルから攻撃力への換算。用語辞典などの「スキル 1 = 攻撃力 1」を採用したが、BG Wiki には命中と同じように段階的に目減りするという記述もある (スキル合計 709 で 71 の差)。(2) 格闘の STR の係数。両 Wiki の 0.75 を採用 (1.0 とする資料もある)。

formulas.accuracy: Accuracy = skillAcc(S) + floor(DEX*0.75) + flat, where S = skill for the weapon in that hand (native skill incl. Master Level, merits and gear 'skill+N', plus that weapon's own item-level skill) and skillAcc is piecewise: S<=200: S; 201-400: 200+floor((S-200)*0.9); 401-600: 380+floor((S-400)*0.8); >=601: 540+floor((S-600)*0.9). flat = accuracy on gear + traits (Accuracy Bonus) + gifts + merits + abilities/songs + flat food. Percentage food is applied last on the whole sum: + min(floor(total*pct/100), cap). DEX multiplier is 0.75 for one-handed, two-handed and hand-to-hand alike, main and off hand alike; main and off hand differ only in which weapon's skill type / item-level skill is used (hand-to-hand: both fists use the H2H weapon's values).
formulas.attack: Attack = 8 + S + strTerm + flat, S entering 1:1 (no piecewise conversion). strTerm: one-handed main hand = STR; two-handed = STR; hand-to-hand = floor(STR*0.75); one-handed off hand = floor(STR*0.5). flat = attack on gear + traits (Attack Bonus) + gifts + flat buffs. Then percentage bonuses (Berserk, Chaos Roll, Smite, Last Resort; Minuet is a flat bonus and belongs in flat) multiply that subtotal: subtotal + floor(subtotal*pct/100); food attack is added after/outside the percentage buffs (percentage food = min(floor(subtotal*pct/100), cap), computed on the pre-buff subtotal). Minimum 1.
formulas.ranged_accuracy: Ranged Accuracy = skillAcc(S) + floor(AGI*0.75) + flat ranged accuracy (gear/traits/gifts/food), same piecewise skillAcc as melee. S = Archery / Marksmanship / Throwing skill according to the weapon in the ranged slot (bow -> 弓術, gun or crossbow -> 射撃, thrown ranged item -> 投てき); if the ranged slot is empty the ammo slot item decides (shuriken etc. -> 投てき); plus that ranged weapon's item-level skill. A bow/gun with no ammo gives 0. Percentage food as for accuracy (use the food's ranged-accuracy values).
formulas.ranged_attack: Ranged Attack = 8 + S + STR + flat ranged attack, S entering 1:1, same skill selection as ranged accuracy; percentage bonuses and food as for Attack (attack-up abilities such as Berserk raise both; food must list ranged attack).

notes: STR->Attack multipliers disagree between sources. BG Strength (history table) and FF11用語辞典 STR/攻撃力 agree: since 2018-12-11 two-handed 1.0, one-handed main 1.0, one-handed off hand 0.5, hand-to-hand 0.75, ranged 1.0. The BG Attack page says only 'all main-hand and ranged weapons 1:1' with off hand floor(STR/2) and does not single out H2H; wsdist uses 1.0 for H2H; LandSandBoat defaults are two-handed 1.0, H2H 1.0, one-handed main 0.75, off hand 0.5, ranged 1.0 (LSB does not match either wiki for one-handed/H2H, so it was not used as tie-break here). reference_js uses the two-wiki consensus (H2H 0.75).

Skill->Attack: the BG Attack and Ranged_Attack pages contain a sentence (added Oct 2019) saying combat skill 'translates into Attack in differing skill tiers, similar to Accuracy', yet give the formula 8 + Combat Skill + STR. FF11用語辞典 (攻撃力, 武器スキル: 武器スキル+1 = 攻撃力+1), LandSandBoat and wsdist all use skill 1:1. A developer post quoted on wiki.ffo.jp/html/29333.html equates 武器スキル+242 to roughly 攻+195/命中+195 and +269 to 攻+216/命中+216 ('values differ slightly in practice'), which would hint that attack is also reduced; unresolved - reference_js uses 1:1. Check against /checkparam in game: with total skill 709 the two models differ by 71 attack.

Percentage attack and food ordering/rounding is not precisely documented. JP: (base + gear + flat) * percent + food. LSB: ATT + ATT*ATTP/100 + min(ATT*FOOD_ATTP/100, FOOD_ATT_CAP) with integer truncation, i.e. food % is taken from the pre-buff subtotal. reference_js follows LSB; truncation of the percentage term is unverified for retail (retail buffs are often n/1024 fractions).
Accuracy percentage food: JP 命中 says the % is applied after skill/gear/abilities/songs with floor, e.g. 450 with Salmon Sushi (+14%, cap 68) -> int(450*1.14) = 513. LSB does the same with the cap.
LSB adds Mod TWOHAND_ACC for two-handed weapons and merit Accuracy separately; treat those as part of 'flat'.

Job rating disagreement: BLU 片手棍 is B- on BG (Combat_Skills and Blue_Mage), LSB and wiki.ffo.jp/html/2570.html, but B on wiki.ffo.jp/html/433.html; B- used. All other 329 job/skill cells are identical across BG, JP 433 and LSB.
Subjob skills: a skill only the support job has is capped by the subjob's rating at the subjob level (LSB); not covered by job_ratings, which is main job at 99.
Ranged skill selection (ranged slot first, then ammo; no ammo -> 0) is from LSB and wsdist, the wikis only say 'the ranged combat skill for the currently equipped ranged weapon'.
JP 飛命 page only mentions the 0.9 step above 200 for ranged accuracy; BG Ranged_Accuracy, LSB and wsdist use the full four-tier table, used here.
The old LSB files sql/skill_caps.sql and sql/skill_ranks.sql no longer exist on the base branch; the data moved to data/skills.yaml (and scripts/data/skill_ranks.lua).
Samples marked 'computed' are computed from the cited formulas, not taken from in-game measurements.
